protocol.method: Exactly replay original student states. Clone complete env state for each +/-0.1 forward/common and turn/differential wheel perturbation per robot. Compare per-robot reward and matched point error. Try one simultaneous finite-gradient reward-ascent action as an evaluator-only counterfactual.
protocol.boundary: Truth, fitted targets, derivatives and counterfactual commands never enter actor inputs, PPO rollouts, action masks or candidate selection. No controller or acceptance claim.

interpretation: Local reward responsiveness only. A one-step privileged counterfactual does not prove long-term control, success or actor observability. Per-robot point progress and the all-five maximum are different objectives; all acceptance gates remain unchanged.
